landingPage.heroTitle: AstroWind website template for startups and SaaS
landingPage.heroDescription: A popular open-source Astro and Tailwind CSS starter with ready-made home, landing, pricing and blog pages, deployed on Hostinger at a reviewed version.
landingPage.about: AstroWind is one of the most popular open-source website starters for Astro, built with Tailwind CSS by its original authors. It gives a startup, SaaS product or agency a complete marketing site from the first deploy: several home page styles, landing pages for lead generation and launches, pricing, services, about and contact pages, plus a blog with categories, tags and an RSS feed. SEO metadata, a sitemap and a dark mode are already wired in. The site builds to fast static pages, and you shape it by editing Astro components and Markdown files. Hostinger deploys the original project at a version we have checked, so you start from the real AstroWind code and its MIT license.

features.title: Home page variants
features.description: Start from SaaS, startup, mobile app or personal home pages and keep the one that fits.

features.title: Landing pages
features.description: Lead generation, click-through, pre-launch and product pages ready for campaigns.

features.title: Blog included
features.description: Markdown and MDX posts with categories, tags, pagination and an RSS feed.

features.title: SEO built in
features.description: Meta tags, Open Graph data, a sitemap and robots rules are generated with every build.

features.title: Dark mode
features.description: A light and dark theme switch that remembers each visitor's choice.

features.title: Fast static pages
features.description: The site builds to static HTML and CSS, so pages load quickly on any connection.
